notes.title: BIG SUMMER UPDATE / NEW SKIN AND GAME IMPROVEMENTS
notes.content:
Specially for the Summer sale Slavania received not only a 20% discount, but also a new summer skin, which will be received by all players who bought Slavania before the end of the Summer sale. Moreover, in the last couple of days we rolled out 2 new patches at once.

Since the Slavania release the FrostLeaf Games team worked without sleep or rest to improve the game. We looked for bugs, read your comments and reviews, conducted multiple additional playtests.

With undisguised joy, we inform you that we managed to bring the game to an almost perfect state. Some small problems may still appear, but we carefully monitor your feedback and will continue to eliminate even the smallest bugs, if any.

Below is a full list of changes in patches 1.0.5-1.0.6

• Added: Alyosha's summer skin
• Added: Discord link
• Added: Cloud saves
• Added: Gleb's chest map
• Added: Unripe tangerine
• Added: Quest guides
• Added: Quest markers on the map
• Added: Last night message

• Reworked: Menu navigation with a gamepad
• Reworked: Map design
• Reworked: Armor stones auto-recovery
• Reworked: Using all abilities is now free
• Reworked: Boss fight start after hunting
• Reworked: Boss Koschei, Pechka
• Reworked: Ability: Dash down, slide and dash in the air.
• Reworked: Koschei's Castle visuals
• Reworked: Slime, Deer, Leshy hunt
• Reworked: monsters: shadow walker
• Reworked: some bosses

• Fixed: game crashes
• Fixed: jumping from a slide with a double jump and claws on bast shoes
• Fixed: slide after pink bubbles
• Fixed: some downward dash scenarios
• Fixed: minor edits on levels
• Fixed: some Gleb chests
• Fixed: skipping the intro video with a user command when it is impossible to play a video file
• Fixed: falling off a jump
• Fixed: some quests
• Fixed: cameras in some dialogues
• Fixed: some markers on the map
• Fixed: chase with Leshy in the Bloody Forest
• Fixed: markers on the map
• Fixed: sometimes stopped ability to work (jump, double jump, dash)
• Fixed: quick access item change panel
• Fixed: UI
• Fixed: Vavula, blacksmith, merchant Gleb, buffoons, Gamayun dialogues
• Fixed: fight with Koschei
• Fixed: ability and item descriptions
• Fixed: Gleb's chest
• Fixed: camera behavior in some situations (dialogues, cinematics)
• Fixed: abilities: double jump, dash, dash down, grab, jump with spear push
• Fixed: quests: Finding Alena, Reviving cows, Broken bridge, Saving the blacksmith
• Fixed: dialogue start: removed reasons for receiving damage in some cases
• Fixed: opponents: squawkers getting stuck in cracks, Petrushka from the box
• Fixed: many cinematics
• Fixed: broken animation in the world of the dead after the first death
• Fixed: transition between layers (doors, caves)
• Fixed: lvl Mazurovo, Road to Dremleno, Waterfall, Old Lake, Tales of Animals, Road to Dremleno
• Fixed: freezing after death
• Fixed: repeating the start of the game on Steamdeck after skipping the introductory video

Once again, we express our huge gratitude to all our players, we are incredibly happy to make the game for you <3

notes.title: PATCH 1.0.4 – CHINESE LANGUAGE AND A LOT OF UPDATES
notes.content:
Slavania has progressed a lot over the last 4 patches! Today we have not only made a number of changes and improvements, but also added Chinese to the game so that even more players can immerse themselves in the updated Slavania!

• Added: Chinese (simplified) localization

• Reworked: more detailed map with level silhouettes
• Redesigned: map management interface
• Reworked: climbing onto a spear, the animation has become less jerky, Alyosha does not play the fall animation after climbing on a spear
• Reworked: changing quick access items with the mouse wheel and on the gamepad is implemented differently and has become more convenient
• Reworked: looking up/down works more pleasantly: it works faster, returns faster and more clearly

• Fixed: You can no longer take damage or die during the boss summoning animation
• Fixed: after a boss fight with Koshchei, while pulling a spear, you could drink poison and break the final cutscene
• Fixed: Siege of Novgorod. It is no longer possible to jump over the cinematic start trigger near the idol using teleport or dash in the air
• Fixed: Crypt. Buffoons. It was possible to get out of the hole with the help of a grabber without breaking the statue. Now there's a locked door
• Fixed: Alyosha sometimes rode on his back after death
• Fixed: added a room change fuse, in case the camera for some reason remains in the previous one
• Fixed: Static enemies jumped or moved if a spear was stuck under them (Beehive, Screaming Stump, Curolisk, Screamer's Nest, Dandelion, Midday Scarecrow)
• Fixed: the spear now sticks more regularly and becomes a platform
• Fixed: portal bug in Novgorod
• Fixed: trumpet animation twitching
• Fixed: dialog layout corrected
• Fixed: layout of the main menu and settings for widescreen screens
• Fixed: control lock before starting boss fight
• Fixed: Camera stability has been increased
• Removed: Toad monster. I worked with bugs that were impossible to fix. F.

We are actively working on the next “Golden Patch”, which will bring the game to almost perfect technical condition. In addition, we are preparing a number of surprises for our players, so stay in touch and follow us on Steam.

notes.title: PATCH 1.0.3 – LIST OF CHANGES AND FIXES
notes.content:

• Added: input rebinding

• Reworked: fps drop new Idol and other interactable objects

• Fixed: false corrupted save-file message
• Fixed: issuing a hidden system quest about the availability of the ball and the opening of shooting galleries on the idol
• Fixed: eventualy hero stuck ainimation after got damage. 
• Fixed: eventualy hero not stand up after respawn
• Fixed: spear return damage upgrade turn off levers

Our team continues to work hard on the next update, which will be available next week!

notes.title: PATCH 1.0.2 – LIST OF CHANGES AND FIXES
notes.content:
• Added a pointer to the transition between rooms and levels
• Added a death notice due to the days timer to make it clear why the character suddenly died and returned to the idol
• Added high jump from tackle

• Reworked: (gamepad) the D-pad no longer duplicates the stick
• Reworked: (gamepad) interaction has been removed from the stick and moved up to the D-pad
• Reworked: (keyboard) interaction moved to E key
Work continues on the ability to reconfigure keys for each player
• Reworked: too large death FX of some monsters have been reduced
• Reworked: Shadow Walker's health has been reduced and his reaction has been slowed down.
• Reworked: interaction time for dialogue has been reduced to 0.5 seconds
• Reworked: Screamer's nest spawns one Screamer instead of two
• Reworked: reduced speed of falling poison drop
• Reworked: increased the base speed of carts on ropes
• Reworked: location of consumables in the Road to Dremleno, added a mark on the map with a second idol for orientation in the Road to Dremleno
• Reworked: fly agaric no longer kills Alyosha after expiration
• Reworked: under the influence of the Invisibility Cap, Alyosha moves one and a half times faster, which gives more scenarios for using the item
• Reworked: double jump height increased
• Reworked: Alyosha is teleported to a given bossfight starting point every time at the beginning of the battle

• Fixed: notifications with important information disappear quickly
• Fixed: attack on the second deer after finishing the deer hunt
• Fixed: numerous small changes (visual and physical) at the levels Hunt for the Slug, Road to the Crypt, Strange Mountain, Sacred Grove, Road to Dremleno, Old Lake
• Fixed: the snake in Mazurovo issued a quest after completing “The Shepherd Kosiposha and his Flock” on the shepherd’s side
• Fixed: merchant Gleb endlessly issues the quest "Cow from Dough"
• Fixed: added an idol leading to the final location through fast travel
• Fixed: Koshchei could be defeated after breaking a needle on the Road to Novgorod level
• Fixed: some English localization texts have been edited
• Fixed: bug in the Forest of Robbers
• Fixed: bug with falling into textures when swinging on a spear
• Fixed: bug with falling under the bridge during the first meeting with a pike
• Fixed: flying sandals, if you take them from Gleb
• Fixed: Hints in the interface recommending replenishing your health
• Fixed: a downward dash with pumped-up damage now gives the effect of invulnerability and Alyosha should not receive damage even when landing on a monster’s head
• Fixed: spring bugs that occurred when receiving damage at the moment of rebound (animations could break, Alyosha could jump in a lying position, etc.)
• Fixed: Tsar Pike received direct damage to the head, although there should be armor there and the only weak point is the heart inside the mouth. + minor corrections in behavior. Now the boss should work as intended, and not be killed in two point-blank combos
• Fixed: the invisible hat broke the story scenes. Now starting a cinematic or dialogue cancels the effect of the invisibility cap
• Fixed: Koschey, Tsar-Pike and Leshy have acquired immunity to the Flower-of-the-Marigold item
• Fixed: Alyosha gets stuck in doors when they push him into the ceiling or floor
• Fixed: it was possible to talk to npcs after they went into the portal
• Fixed: plants try not to spawn in front of the player
• Fixed: torn Old Slime, Koshchei's protruding bone and other visual bugs when restarting a bossfight
• Fixed: fix for falling under the bridge with the blacksmith

The list is long, but that’s not all. We are actively working on the next patch, which will include Chinese localization. And we are working on features that will make the controls and interface more user friendly, which is what players are asking us for.

And again, endless gratitude to all those who support Slavania, it is you who make us and the game better!

notes.title: PATCH 1.0.1 – LIST OF FIXES & CHANGES
notes.content:
• Reworked Interaction with objects and NPCs. Now there is no annoying sound and pop-up alert
• Redesigned the settings menu and divided into sections for convenience.

• Added brightness and contrast settings
• Added gibberish volume setting.
• Added vertical sync.
• Added hints for interaction with active objects (dialogues, doors). They look like an icon above the interaction object instead of an alert with sound.
• Added an additional idol to the "Old Lake" location.

• Fixed: the layout of the dialogue interface for Steam Deck
• Fixed: a bug with a yellow circle above the head and a black one in Mazurowo.
• Fixed: Yevgeny refuses to talk at the first meeting.
• Fixed: places in the Mugger forest where Alyosha fell into the textures.
• Fixed: half zombie collider (monster that appears when killing zombies).
• Fixed: the left lift in Mazurovo, it no longer pushes Alyosha into the ceiling.
• Fixed: a bug with textures falling out in the village of Mazurovo.

All the above changes are just the beginning. We are actively working on new patches and tried to include in the first patch as much as possible of what can be implemented and fixed quickly.
We look forward to your feedback and plan to spend much more time responding to players on Steam.

Thank you again for your support and stay tuned for our news! Support and development of the game is not limited to bug fixes alone!

notes.title: The patch with the first fixes is already around the corner!
notes.content:
We actively read all your comments on the game and tirelessly fix bugs that our players encounter. In fact, the first patch is already ready, we are currently testing it before uploading it to Steam.

Unfortunately, we do not have time to respond to most of the players, because all our efforts are devoted to technical work on the game, but rest assured, we hear you and are working to improve your gaming experience as much as possible!

Moreover, over the next few weeks we will be adding a number of new languages to Slavnia, including Chinese and Brazilian Portuguese, which will come first.

Thank you again for your feedback, your support and for working with us to improve the Slavania <3

notes.title: В преддверии нового демо Славании
notes.content:
Со времени последнего поста мы продолжали работу, не останавливаясь ни на день. И конечно же игра преобразилась. Вот некоторые нововведения, которые появились в Славании. [/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Уже отрисовано более 8-ми новых разнообразных локаций.[/b]
[*] [b]Появились 5 свежих боссов, которые ждут сражения.[/b]
[*] [b]Арсенал использования копья расширился четырьмя новыми крутыми навыками. Некоторые из них имеют несколько вариантов применения. [/b]
[*] [b]В магазин купца Глеба привезли целый вагон различных супер-полезных артефактов.[/b]
[*] [b]В игре появился саундтрек для каждой локации. Варианты есть как для дневного времени, так и для ночного. [/b]
[*] [b]Добавлена озвучка персонажей. Они говорят на специально придуманном славанском языке. [/b]
[*] [b]Так же добавили кучу новых монстров и неигровых персонажей. [/b]
[/list]

[previewyoutube=OlpeNbLRtBI;full][/previewyoutube]

Как вы видите,  с момента выкладки нашей последний демки поменялось очень многое. И она безнадежно устарела. Мы хотим обновить ее, добавив туда хотя бы часть из вышеперечисленного. Некоторое время текущая демка не будет функционировать. Но мы работаем над тем, чтобы как можно быстрее выложить обновленную классную демку! 

[b]Подробнее о всех новинках можно будет узнать из наших соцсетей, а также более крупные анонсы будут появляться и в этом блоге. [/b]

notes.title: Big Demo Update
notes.content:
We've been working hard to make the next big update. We've accepted lot's of feedback and made great changes in the game.
[i]Old save files will be not compatible with new game version. If you have played before and do not want to start all from the beginning you can use "Chapter" button in "Start Game" menu.
[/i]
Changelog:
- Completely reworked "Road to Dremleno" level
- Added keyboard + mouse input
- Added free aim instead of 8-direction
- Added new enemies
- Added graphic and audio settings
- Tuned the battle system
- Made Kikimora trader alive
- Improved hud
- Improved gamepad input
- Improved performance
- Made lot of bug fixes
- Removed extra meaningless dialogues
